module: Third-party library: LuaJIT's jit.vmdef (Mike Pall), a generated file ("DO NOT EDIT") that contains the LuaJIT VM name tables: names of bytecodes, trace compiler IR instructions, built-in fast functions, trace errors, etc. It is used by LuaJIT tools (profiler, trace dump). No function: read-only data only.
notes: The bytecode (bcnames) and IR (irnames) names are strings with fixed-width columns of 6 characters, not tables.
File generated by LuaJIT: do not modify it; it must match the embedded LuaJIT version.

bcnames.desc: LuaJIT bytecode opcode names concatenated, 6 characters per name.

irnames.desc: Names of the trace compiler IR instructions concatenated, 6 characters per name.

irfpm.desc: Math functions of the IR operation FPMATH (floor, ceil, trunc, sqrt, exp, exp2, log, log2, log10, sin, cos, tan, other), 0-based.

irfield.desc: Names of the internal object fields read by the IR (str.len, func.env, tab.meta, tab.array, cdata.ptr…), 0-based.

ircall.desc: Names of the C functions called from the IR (CALL), 0-based.

traceerr.desc: JIT compiler trace abort error messages, 0-based.

ffnames.desc: Names of LuaJIT's built-in fast functions.
